quiz.question: At 65.8s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "For ________ 18 months or so before I really quit. So why did I drop out?"?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 65.8 秒處，講者提到「又過了18個月左右，我才真正戒菸。那我為什麼退學呢？」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「For another 18 months or so before I really quit. So why did I drop out?」（又過了18個月左右，我才真正戒菸。那我為什麼退學呢？）。其中「another (n./v.)」意為「另一個」。

quiz.question: At 261.9s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "It all came back to me. And we designed it all into the Mac. It was the first computer with beautiful ________."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 261.9 秒處，講者提到「這一切我都想起來了。我們將這一切都設計到了 Mac 中。這是第一台具有漂亮排版的計算機。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「It all came back to me. And we designed it all into the Mac. It was the first computer with beautiful typography.」（這一切我都想起來了。我們將這一切都設計到了 Mac 中。這是第一台具有漂亮排版的計算機。）。其中「typography (n./v.)」意為「版式」。

quiz.question: At 454.5s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "________ company named Pixar, and fell in love with an amazing woman who would become my wife."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 454.5 秒處，講者提到「另一家名為皮克斯的公司，愛上了一位了不起的女人，她後來成為了我的妻子。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「Another company named Pixar, and fell in love with an amazing woman who would become my wife.」（另一家名為皮克斯的公司，愛上了一位了不起的女人，她後來成為了我的妻子。）。其中「another (n./v.)」意為「另一個」。

quiz.question: At 656.7s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "It means to say your goodbyes. I lived with that ________ all day."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 656.7 秒處，講者提到「意思是說再見。我一整天都帶著這樣的診斷過日子。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「It means to say your goodbyes. I lived with that diagnosis all day.」（意思是說再見。我一整天都帶著這樣的診斷過日子。）。其中「diagnosis (n./v.)」意為「診斷」。

quiz.question: At 805.8s in the video, which word best completes the sentence: "This was in the late 1960's, before personal computers and desktop publishing, so it was all made with ________, scissors, and polaroid cameras."?
quiz.questionZh: 在影片 805.8 秒處，講者提到「那是在 20 世纪 60 年代末，在个人电脑和桌面出版出现之前，所以这一切都是用打字机、剪刀和宝丽莱相机制作的。」，空格中應填入哪個字彙？
quiz.explanation: 原句為：「This was in the late 1960's, before personal computers and desktop publishing, so it was all made with typewriters, scissors, and polaroid cameras.」（那是在 20 世纪 60 年代末，在个人电脑和桌面出版出现之前，所以这一切都是用打字机、剪刀和宝丽莱相机制作的。）。其中「typewriter (n./v.)」意為「打字機」。
